description: The plot illustrates the similarity of Hidden State Alignments (HSAs) in different languages across layers within the Qwen1.5-1.8B model. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, with tick marks at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Similarity” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.45, with tick marks at 0.05 intervals. The line labeled “en&en” is red, solid, and begins at approximately 0.07 at layer 0, rising to a peak of approximately 0.29 at layer 5, then decreasing to approximately 0.11 at layer 18, and concluding at approximately 0.44 at layer 22. The line labeled “en&es” is light blue, solid, and starts at approximately 0.06 at layer 0, and shows a gradual decline to approximately 0.09 at layer 18, then rises to approximately 0.16 at layer 22. The line labeled “en&el” is green, solid, and rises from 0.05 from layer 0 to a peak of approximately 0.14 at layer 2, then falls to a low of approximately 0.06 at layer 18 before increasing to approximately 0.11 at layer 22. Finally, the line labeled “en&bn” is magenta, solid, and begins at approximately 0.05 at layer 0, attains a peak of approximately 0.15 at layer 4, and decreases to approximately 0.06 at layer 18, then rises sharply to approximately 0.42 at layer 22.
